scope: Read-only APSearch verification; no model calls
original_nl: Find Arabic field recordings in CKG APSearch published by the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities, with their recording dates

predicates.query:
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX apsearch: <https://linkedmusic.ca/graphs/ckg-apsearch/>
SELECT ?predicate (COUNT(*) AS ?triples) WHERE {
GRAPH apsearch: { ?s ?predicate ?o } } GROUP BY ?predicate ORDER BY DESC(?triples)
